title: The dynamic pressure of flow
hook: Change flow speed and predict dynamic pressure.
misconception: dynamic pressure doubles when flow speed doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply q = ½ρv² to compare dynamic pressure when flow speed changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fluid of fixed density, q = ½ρv². When flow speed doubles, dynamic pressure becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model q = ½ρv²; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fluid of fixed density, with a nonzero initial result. If flow speed triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on dynamic pressure?
recall.why: Apply q = ½ρv² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
